summary: Summit Hotel Properties, Inc. filed an 8-K to report entry into a material definitive agreement—a $650M senior unsecured credit facility (amending and restating the prior facility). The facility includes a $400M revolver (matures 2030, extendable to 2031), a $200M term loan, and a $50M delayed draw term loan, with an accordion up to $900M. There are no acquisition, divestiture, tender, or other special-situation elements. This is a routine refinancing of existing credit arrangements, not a special situation.
